notes: synthetic session: a staging deploy fails on a missing token, then succeeds once the token is loaded
judge: says the first deploy failed because STAGING_TOKEN was not set, and that a later deploy succeeded after the token was loaded from the vault; cites the lines for both

snapshot.question: Why did the staging deploy fail, and is it fixed?
snapshot.title: Deploy web to staging

rows.content: Deploy the web build to staging.

tool_results.content:
Building web... done in 38s
Uploading... Error: STAGING_TOKEN is not set
exit 1

rows.content: The deploy failed at the upload step: STAGING_TOKEN is not set in this shell, so the uploader refused to start. The build itself succeeded.
It is in the team vault now under staging/deploy, load it and try again.

tool_calls.name: Bash
tool_calls.input: {"command": "export STAGING_TOKEN=$(vault read -field=token staging/deploy) && bun run deploy:staging"}

tool_results.content:
Building web... done in 36s
Uploading... done
Deployed to staging in 41s

rows.content: Deployed to staging after loading STAGING_TOKEN from the vault. The staging site serves the new build.
